items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: I know him. He's never the player anymore.

ctx.x: He plays with the Eureka. You know him.
I know him. He's never the player anymore. He's too much to my time.
Peter Bocas and Charlie Love. Yeah, he's playing the violin. Yeah. Paul Bonds is playing the clarinet. Yeah. Manuel Sells on banjo. See what all you want. Good.
